browser-support.title: Browser Support
browser-support.description: The HTML-in-Canvas API is an experimental WICG proposal currently implemented behind a flag in Chromium. It is not yet available in stable Chrome, Firefox, or Safari.

getting-started.title: Getting Started
getting-started.description: refrag is a React library that brings real HTML, CSS, and accessible DOM elements inside a `` using the experimental HTML-in-Canvas API. Your component tree becomes a live WebGL texture — styled, interactive, and screen-reader-accessible — ready to use in 2D, WebGL, or WebGPU rendering contexts.

html-shader.title: HtmlShader
html-shader.description: HtmlShader is the primary component in refrag. It mounts a ``, renders your React children as a live DOM subtree inside it via the HTML-in-Canvas API, and exposes that subtree as a WebGL texture that your fragment shader can sample.

is-api-supported.title: isApiSupported
is-api-supported.description: A utility function that detects whether the HTML-in-Canvas API is available in the current browser.

use-html-texture.title: useHtmlTexture
use-html-texture.description: useHtmlTexture is an escape-hatch hook for when you need to drive your own WebGL context, Three.js scene, or any other rendering pipeline with an HTML texture.
